title: Product Graph Scope Artifact
description: Output of the BA Agent (v1). Describes WHAT SHOULD BE for one feature: the process-plane Feature plus the proposed/ratified knowledge-plane nodes and edges produced while scoping it. The BA Agent owns product Concepts (CON-*) and holds the CON-* -> [cbc:*] join via concept.maps_to_codebase; the Codebase Context Agent owns cbc:* and never reads this artifact. This is the on-disk mirror of the product_graph.graph_nodes / graph_edges tables (migration 024) and the write contract for the public.graph_* RPCs. Column/field names match the migration exactly. Epistemic status and scope readiness are DERIVED (public.graph_node_epistemic_status / public.graph_feature_readiness), never stored — readiness is echoed here for convenience only. v1 primitives: Feature, Concept, Question, Decision. Rule and Attribute are DEFERRED but pre-stubbed inside decision.node_attributes (implies_rules / implies_attributes) so they promote by migration, not rescoping.

run_id.description: Oversight telemetry run_id for this BA scoping run.

product_key.description: Product/repo scope, mirrors codebase-context target_key, e.g. 'reformai-product'. Matches graph_nodes.product_key.

tenant_id.description: Company isolation id. Matches graph_nodes.tenant_id. Set as app.current_tenant_id when writing via RPC. See LESSONS: never resolve company via LIMIT 1.

feature_key.description: The FEAT-* node this artifact scopes. Present in nodes[] as node_type=feature.

scoped_against.description: The codebase-context artifact this scoping consumed. Records the IS-state reality the SHOULD-BE was scoped against, for staleness detection.

inputs.description: Echo of the invocation inputs for reproducibility.

feature_intent.description: The raw feature idea. Becomes the feature node title.

nodes.description: All graph_nodes produced/touched this run (feature + concepts + questions + decisions). One-to-one with product_graph.graph_nodes rows. Write via public.graph_upsert_node.

edges.description: All graph_edges produced this run. One-to-one with product_graph.graph_edges rows. Write via public.graph_add_edge. Endpoints are node_key values resolved to ids by the RPC.

readiness.description: Convenience echo of public.graph_feature_readiness(product_key, feature_key). DERIVED, never stored. The DB function is authoritative; this snapshot is for human/brief consumption only.

gate_contradiction_check.description: Gate 4 is a known v1 gap; contradiction detection arrives with a later migration.

brief_markdown.description: The rendered Feature Brief — a projection over the nodes/edges above. Disposable presentation layer; never a source of truth. Only rendered when readiness.scope_ready is true (or marked PROVISIONAL otherwise).

cbc_id.description: Code-side identity owned by the Codebase Context Agent (registry-frozen). Pattern is identical to codebase-context.schema.json by contract. The BA never mints these — it reads them from concept_resolution[].cbc_ids and stores them in concept.maps_to_codebase.

node_common.description: Columns shared by every graph_nodes row.

title.description: intent | concept name | question text | decision statement.

ratified_by.description: Set only on transition into accepted/handed_off (via public.graph_ratify_node).

notes.description: Low-divergence non-blocking assumptions, captured as notes (Assumption-as-node is deferred in v1).

clarification_brief_artifact_id.description: Pointer to the PCA clarification_brief artifact that seeded this feature (Agile front-door link; surfaced in the Scoping dashboard).

title.description: Canonical concept name (product noun, not the code identifier).

kind.description: Emergent, human-ratified vocabulary: actor | entity | workflow | event | integration | ... Open set; new kinds require ratification, not migration.

maps_to_codebase.description: Plural. cbc:* identities this concept binds to (e.g. an actor backed by both an auth role and a table). The drift-detection join key. Frozen on consumption: once stored, the cbc_id is authoritative even if the code later renames. GIN-indexed in graph_nodes.

aliases.description: Synonyms folded into this concept (anti-duplicate). The BA resolves incoming nouns against title + aliases before minting a new concept.

blocking.description: Only blocking + high-divergence questions gate scope readiness.

divergence.description: How much the answer changes the design. Only 'high' blocks.

title.description: The decision statement (the ratified choice). A rejected alternative is a separate decision_node with status=rejected.

ratified_by.description: The human who accepted/rejected. Decisions are the only fact-minting node and are immutable once accepted — supersede, never edit.

rationale.description: Why this choice. Irreplaceable — decisions are the least-recoverable asset.

implies_rules.description: Forward-compat stub. Plain-language rule statements this decision establishes. Promoted to Rule nodes by a later migration; unused by the v1 brief.

implies_attributes.description: Forward-compat stub. Concept field sets this decision implies. Promoted to non-sovereign Attribute components by a later migration.

edge_type.description: references: any node -> concept (traceability/citation). resolves: decision -> question|assumption-equivalent. supersedes: node -> same-type node (versioning). derived_from: provenance.

src_key.description: Source node_key. Resolved to id by public.graph_add_edge.

edge_attributes.description: Edge-type-specific. For references, nature carries impact without a new edge type.
